```{r}
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(exactextractr)
```
# Natura 2000

```{r}
natura<-st_read(here("raw_data/Natura2000/Natura2000_end2021_rev1_epsg3035.shp"))  %>% 
  st_transform(., 3035)
  
```


# EEZ

```{r}
eez<-st_read(here("raw_data/EEZ/eez_simple.shp")) %>% 
   st_make_valid(.) %>% 
  st_transform(., 3035)
```

```{r}
eez_natura<-st_intersection(eez,natura) %>% 
  mutate(natura_km2 = as.numeric(st_area(.)*1e-6))

eez_natura<-eez_natura %>%
  select(rgn_key, area_km2, natura_km2)
```

# Infrastructure data
```{r}
wind_points<-st_read(here("output_data/offshore_wind/GWPT_offshore_wind_point_locations_developed.shp")) %>% 
  st_transform(., 3035)

wind25<-st_read(here("output_data/offshore_wind/GWPT_Wind_buffer_25km_developed.shp")) %>% 
  st_transform(., 3035)
wind15<-st_read(here("output_data/offshore_wind/GWPT_Wind_buffer_15km_developed.shp")) %>% 
  st_transform(., 3035)
wind1<-st_read(here("output_data/offshore_wind/GWPT_Wind_buffer_1km_developed.shp")) %>% 
  st_transform(., 3035)
```


# Infrastructure intersect

Number of infrastructure
```{r}
natura_num_wind<-st_intersection(eez_natura, wind_points)

natura_wind_count<-natura_num_wind %>% 
  mutate(count = 1) %>%
  group_by(rgn_key) %>% 
  summarise(num_wind = sum(count, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  mutate(type = "Natura2000") %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  select(-geometry)
```

```{r}
write.csv(natura_wind_count, here("output_data/GWPT_results/GWPT_Natura_wind_count.csv"))
```


Area for buffers

```{r}
natura_wind25<-st_intersection(eez_natura, wind25) %>% 
  mutate(int_km2 = as.numeric(st_area(.)*1e-6),
         buff = 25) %>% 
  select(-diss)
```

```{r}
natura_wind15<-st_intersection(eez_natura, wind15) %>% 
  mutate(int_km2 = as.numeric(st_area(.)*1e-6),
         buff = 15) %>% 
  select(-diss)
```

```{r}
natura_wind1<-st_intersection(eez_natura, wind1) %>% 
  mutate(int_km2 = as.numeric(st_area(.)*1e-6),
         buff = 1) %>% 
  select(-diss)
```

```{r}
all_buff<-rbind(natura_wind25, natura_wind15, natura_wind1) %>% 
  mutate(prop_int = int_km2/natura_km2,
         type = "Natura2000") %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  select(-geometry)
```

```{r}
write.csv(all_buff, here("output_data/GWPT_results/GWPT_Natura_wind_area.csv"))
```
